dashboard.label: Topology Settings
dashboard.description: Device roles for the Network Overview topology. Patterns map host names to a role; the topology places devices by role

input.label: Add: pattern (* matches any text, for example ibk-lab-sw*)
Delete: selected entry (click a row in the table below)

ul.li: Submit adds the pattern and role when a pattern is filled in, and deletes the selected entry when one is selected. Both can happen with one Submit.
Patterns are host names. * matches any text. A device takes the role of the longest pattern that matches it.
Roles: core, distribution and access are the rows of the tree, top to bottom. APs (wifi) are always the bottom row and need no entry.
wlc, firewall and server are not in the tree: they sit in a side column to the right.
Devices without a role are placed one row below their highest neighbour by CDP link. Devices not reached from a role device go to the islands block on the far right.
Changes show on Network Overview after its next refresh (1 minute).

search.query: | inputlookup mdt_device_roles | eval refresh="$table_refresh$" | sort 0 pattern | table _key pattern role
| makeresults | eval pattern=trim("$form.new_pattern|s$"), role="$form.new_role|s$" | where len(pattern) > 0 | fields pattern role | outputlookup append=true mdt_device_roles
